INVALID_TRANSITION: This assignment cannot change to that state
AGENT_BUSY: This agent is already running a task
INVALID_PAIRING_CODE: The pairing code is invalid, expired or already used
INVALID_API_KEY: Invalid or revoked computer API key
TOOL_LIMIT: Too many changes in one run (limit {max}); stop and report to the user
TASK_RUN_NO_ASSIGN: A task run cannot assign work to agents; leave that to the reviewer
TASK_RUN_NO_DONE: A task run cannot mark a task done; review stays a human decision
TASK_RUN_NO_REVIEW_CHANGE: A task run cannot change whether a task requires review; that is a human decision
SKILL_NO_ADMIN: A skill of this agent was last saved by someone who is not an owner or admin, so this run cannot use admin tools (create_agent, update_agent); an owner or admin must review and save the skill again
TASK_RUN_NO_ADMIN: A task run cannot use admin tools (create_agent, update_agent); ask the user to do it in the app
